notes: 10 new worlds: depths 11 to 20 (Crimson Bog, Glass Desert, Sunken Belfry, Ironroot Thicket, Aurora Fields, Cinder Cathedral, The Hive, Frozen Abyss, Eclipse Spire and The Hollow Moon).
New world twists: foes that heal over time, bigger swarms, and tougher foes.
Difficulty: Easy, Normal, Hard or Nightmare on the Play page. Harder nights pay more embers and XP (×0.6 up to ×2.25).
24 new camp upgrades, 32 in all, sorted into Economy, Offense, Defense, Run & boons, Lanterns and Progress.
Ascended III now takes two Ascended II lanterns of the same type merged together.
Fixed the camp upgrade tabs and inner pages shifting when you pick a category.
Major updates now play a short animation the first time you open the game after they arrive.
title: The Deep Nights
